current_evidence: Two WebFetch attempts on the Nov 2026 file returned client_error, so its text and date could not be read; a search of camden.gov.uk lists it next to the earlier 'Camden's Local Area Requirements for Planning Applications 2025' (prod-web-assets.camden.gov.uk/documents/d/guest/lars-2025) and finds nothing newer, so it is probably current but this is not verified.

issues.detail: List date 2026-11-01 comes from the URL slug ('nov-2026'), not from any adoption or publication date in the document. It could not be checked against the text.

Many tab_items and app_type_rows are sourced from the superseded 'LARs 2020 (republished)' PDF (documents/20142/12053822/LARs+2020...t=1645193008819) rather than the current list. Examples: Drainage Strategy/SuDS, Highways/access, Housing mix, Planning Obligations, Schedule of works, Transport Assessment, Travel Plan, Ventilation/Extraction, Floor plans, and the scale bar / North arrow and 'proportionate plans' drawing standards.
issues.evidence: LARs 2025 title: 'Camden's Local Area Requirements for Planning Applications 2025' supersedes the 2020 republication

issues.detail: Householder is marked '(none)', but Camden's list has many requirements that apply to householder works: drawings for conservatories/rear extensions (boundary walls, neighbour levels, elevation from the neighbour's side where above the boundary wall); roof extensions/terraces/dormers/window replacement (whole-property elevations, roof sections); basements (sections, lightwells, distances to boundaries) plus a Basement Impact Assessment and Drainage Report for all new or enlarged basements; Tree survey where trees are on or next to the site; Heritage Statement and Photographs for works affecting listed buildings or conservation areas; plans at 1:50 in conservation areas.
issues.evidence: LARs 2025 Section 1b 'Plans and Drawings (specific projects)'; Section 4 'Basement Impact Assessment - developments including new or enlarged basements'

issues.detail: Local requirements in the source that Grokbot did not capture: Affordable housing statement (1+ additional homes and 100sqm+ housing floorspace, student/shared/older people's housing, mixed-use schemes); Student Housing Management Plan (all student accommodation); Structural Report (structural alterations or substantial demolition of a listed building; substantial demolition in a conservation area or of a locally listed building); Air Quality Assessment (all major development, biomass/CHP, substantial earthworks or demolition); Basement Impact Assessment (new or enlarged basements); Biodiversity survey and report (sites within or adjoining SSSI/SNCI/LNR/habitat corridors etc.); CIL information (100sqm+ or 1+ dwelling); Construction Management Plan (all majors and others in Local Plan para 6.13); Contaminated Land Assessment (known or suspected contaminated sites); Daylight and Sunlight Assessment (proposals affecting light to neighbours, 10+ new homes); Delivery and Servicing Management Plan (major commercial); Flood Risk Assessment (sites of 1ha+, majors in flood-risk areas, basements on flood-risk streets); Lighting Assessment (external or floodlighting); Telecommunications Report; Views analysis (LVMF corridors and identified views); Employment and Training Strategy (majors); Regeneration statement (majors); Mini cab use plan, Community use plan and Artwork Management Plan; shopfront, forecourt parking and advertisement drawing requirements.

Several application types are marked '(none)' although the source sets type-specific requirements. Lawful development certificate: drawings showing PD compliance and sworn evidence (rent books, council tax bills, dated photos) for immunity claims. Variation of condition s73 and Non-material amendment: drawings labelled 'as existing / as approved / as proposed', a schedule of differences, and planning statement additional information. Demolition in conservation area: demolition shown on existing plans, sections and elevations, plus Heritage Statement, Photographs and Structural Report. Change of use: existing and proposed floor plans at 1:100.
issues.evidence: LARs 2025 Section 1b items for minor material amendments, non-material amendments, demolition in a conservation area, lawful development certificate and change of use; Section 4 'Evidence for certificates of lawfulness'

issues.detail: The Advertisement consent row 'Floor plans / Elevations' has a trigger excerpt about lawful development certificate evidence ('rent books, evidence of Council tax ... builders receipts') and alterations to approved applications. None of this applies to adverts. The actual advert requirement (illumination details, sections at 1:20 for fascias and projecting signs) is not captured.
issues.evidence: LARs 2025 Section 1b 'Advertisements - illumination details and sections at 1:20 for fascias or projecting signs'

issues.detail: The 'Schedule of works (listed building)' trigger is 'an arboricultural method statement including a tree protection plan', which is tree-survey text. It is also placed under Full planning, but the source requires a Schedule of works for listed building consent applications.
issues.evidence: LARs 2025 Section 3 'Schedule of works - Listed building consent applications'

issues.detail: The Archaeological Assessment trigger runs on into Air Quality Assessment text ('You must submit more detailed AQAs ... busy road, diesel railway lines'). The correct trigger is only new buildings or ground disturbance within an Area of Archaeological Potential.
issues.evidence: LARs 2025 Section 4 'Archaeological assessment - new buildings or ground disturbance within an Area of Archaeological Potential'

issues.detail: Several triggers are garbled or run together from neighbouring entries. Drainage Strategy/SuDS: 'Regeneration statement Sustainable Drainage Systems (SuDS) Strategy Major applications Major applications more, a comprehensive Health Impact Assessment' (it also misses the Drainage Report trigger for all new or extended basements). Photographs/Photomontages: actually the Computer visualisations and drainage pro forma text (Photographs are required for LBC, conservation area demolition, locally listed buildings and setting cases). Transport Assessment and Travel Plan: policy references plus tree-survey text instead of 'all major applications and applications with transport impacts'. Ventilation/Extraction: Acoustic Report trigger text. Crime prevention: management plan 'Code of Conduct' text instead of 'Crime Impact Assessment - major applications'.
issues.evidence: LARs 2025: 'Transport Assessment including a Travel Plan - All major applications and applications with transport impacts'; 'Crime Impact Assessment - Major applications'

issues.detail: Several triggers are cut-off fragments with no condition. Tree Survey: 'requirement for Tree Survey.' (should be: trees within the site or on adjacent land, including street trees). Energy/Sustainability: 'Statement or a Sustainability Statement.' (should be: Energy Statement for all new-build dwellings and 5+ dwellings or 500sqm+; Sustainability Statement for all development, with BREEAM for non-domestic 500sqm+). EIA: 'if an EIA is required.' Highways: 'of vehicles  swept paths.' Planning Statement: page navigation text ('when a planning statement is required what information this document should include'), but the source requires it for all major applications plus specified extra cases. Health Impact Assessment: omits the thresholds (rapid HIA for 10-99 net dwellings or 10,000sqm+; comprehensive for 100+ dwellings).

The Fire Statement trigger quotes only the content of the national form and gives no threshold. A Fire Statement is required only for relevant buildings (18m+ or 7+ storeys with 2+ dwellings or educational accommodation).
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt: 'Fire statements must be submitted on a form published by the Secretary of State ...'

issues.detail: About 20 requirements are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. Several are major-only in the source (Health Impact Assessment, SuDS Strategy, Crime Impact Assessment, Landscaping scheme, Computer visualisations, Waste for majors). Others also apply to householder, LBC or change-of-use cases (Tree survey, Accessibility Statement for conversions, Acoustic Report for plant). So the 'Full planning' placement is misleading in both directions.
issues.evidence: LARs 2025 Section 5 'Major Applications (10+ dwellings net or 1,000 sqm+ additional non-residential floorspace)'

issues.detail: The Listed building consent rows miss source requirements: Photographs, Schedule of works (misfiled under Full planning), Structural Report (structural alterations or substantial demolition), and LBC-specific drawings (internal elevations, sections where floors or ceilings are affected, 1:20 joinery details).
issues.evidence: LARs 2025 Section 1b item 'Listed building consent' and Section 3

issues.detail: Several tab_items are process text, navigation, reference lists or fragments: 'Before uploading any files, please read our guidance notes...'; 'For further information ... contact the duty planner Related pages Pre-planning application advice...'; 'Relevant Neighbourhood Plans Camden Planning Guidance on Housing ... Website information National Planning Policy Framework NPPG Viability...'; 'This should crossreference the annotated plans showing the proposed changes.'; 'You also need to show how you reached your calculation ... Annotate your drawings to confirm if you are cl' (cut off); 'Development does not impact an onsite priority habitat, and is for solely You must submit the completed relevant statutory metric' (garbled BNG exemption text).
issues.evidence: Grokbot tab_items, Submission rules / Drawing standards / Local forms sections

issues.detail: The LBC row 'Character / Conservation area appraisal reference' is a guidance cross-reference ('Listed building and conservation area appraisals') inside the Heritage Statement entry, not a separate requirement. It duplicates the Heritage Statement row.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger: 'building and conservation area appraisals All listed building consent applications.'

issues.detail: Several tab_items appear twice. 'Plans should be proportionate to the nature and size of the proposal, and annotated where appropriate' is listed twice. The scale bar / North arrow rule appears from both the 2020 and Nov 2026 documents. The un-redacted viability assessment sentence is listed twice, once with the reference-list boilerplate attached.

summary: Grokbot's Nov 2026 link appears to be Camden's newest list, but it could not be fetched to confirm, and the list date is taken from the URL. The extraction mixes in the superseded 2020 LARs and marks Householder and most other application types '(none)'. It misses about 20 local requirements, and many triggers are garbled or misfiled. (Checked against Camden's LARs 2025.)

withdrawn_issues.detail: Grokbot's validation list URL could not be fetched (client_error on two attempts), and the 'Planning page' URL (camden.gov.uk/local-area-requirements) is only the Planning Statement guidance page; it does not link the list. The content comparison below was made against the LARs 2025 document. Grokbot's Nov 2026 excerpts match its wording closely (e.g. the Accessibility Statement trigger).
withdrawn_issues.evidence: LARs 2025: 'Camden first published these Local Application Requirements in 2018 ... updated version ... criteria for valid applications are unchanged'
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: The list URL was in fact downloaded: councils.csv says "downloaded & read this run" and the raw copy (Camden Local Area Requirements 2026, 83 KB) is on file, so the "could not be fetched" part is wrong. The point about the Planning page link was not checked.
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. This was a note about what my helpers could not read, not a Grokbot error, so it is removed from the issue counts. The council stays on "Still to check by hand".
